params.caption: 🎮 Disney teases "major announcements" at The Game Awards The Game Awards will stream on Disney+ this year, and Disney says viewers can expect big reveals and surprises from some of its most anticipated games during the show. You won't need Disney+ to watch: the event still streams on YouTube, Twitch and other platforms. Disney gave no further details. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 22:10 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 🤔 React 🔥 if you're curious · 💬 Which Disney game do you want to see revealed? #TheGameAwards #Disney #DisneyPlus #GamingNews
